news.words: Coach Mike Tomlin said quarterback Aaron Rodgers is questionable for Sunday's game against the Chicago Bears at Soldier Field.
Rodgers (wrist), who is officially questionable for Sunday's matchup against Chicago, "has been pushing to play," but Steelers doctors have been "cautious and guarded"
